points.description: States "push" as a main stack operation, correctly described if described at all: adds/inserts an element onto the top of the stack.
points.partial_credit: Names push but gives a wrong or incomplete description; otherwise nothing if push is absent.

points.description: States "pop" as a main stack operation, correctly described if described at all: removes the top element of the stack (LIFO order).
points.partial_credit: Names pop but gives a wrong or incomplete description; otherwise nothing if pop is absent.

rubric.notes: Full marks need both push and pop named with the correct terms, and no wrong operations given as main ones. Each missing operation loses its point. A wrong extra item (e.g. enqueue, dequeue, insert at the bottom) or a swapped description costs the point it affects. Vague wording such as "add and remove" without the terms push and pop earns nothing for that point.
